$comment: Vendored reconstruction of the Antigravity sidecar.json schema, for google-antigravity 0.1.24 (bundled harness binary). Provenance: the harness sidecar docs say 'The sidecar.json file must conform to the following JSON schema' but the schema itself is generated at runtime (utils.ReflectSchema) from a Go struct, so the dump only contains that struct's json/jsonschema tags. Every property and description below is copied from those tags (strings dump lines 257098-280837) and cross-checked against the exa.cortex_pb.SidecarConfig / SidecarUIConfig / SidecarUIView / SidecarAgentPermissions / SidecarSandboxConfig proto descriptors (lines ~415600-415690). 'required' follows the Go convention of the reflector (json tags without omitempty are required). additionalProperties=false is the reflector's default and is an assumption. Proto-only fields with no JSON tag found (disabled, arguments, view url) are deliberately excluded.

command.description: The command to execute (e.g. python3). Mutually exclusive with builtin.

builtin.description: A builtin command to execute. Mutually exclusive with command.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command

restart_policy.description: Restart policy for the sidecar. Options: always, on-failure, never. Defaults to always.

description.description: Description of what the sidecar does. Make sure this is accurate and up-to-date.

has_web_ui.description: Whether the sidecar has a web UI. If true, the system will inject the web server port.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the sidecar.

display_name.description: Display name for the sidecar UI.

ui_config.description: Static UI configuration for the sidecar.

display_name.description: Display name for the sidecar UI tab.

views.description: Available UI views for the sidecar.

path.description: The URL path served by the sidecar (e.g., /auxpane).

entrypoint.description: Where the UI is displayed. SIDEBAR renders full-pane like FULL_PANE and is also listed as a tab in the sidebar's Plugins section.

title.description: Display title for the sidecar UI view.

file_extensions.description: File extensions (with leading dot) that open in this view instead of the default file viewer.

url_schemes.description: Reserved for URL schemes without the trailing colon (such as vscode) whose links this view can open. Currently has no effect.

title_bar_style.description: Title bar style for full-pane views (/view/$viewId). Set to SIDECAR_UI_TITLE_BAR_STYLE_HIDDEN when the plugin renders its own header/inset.

agent_permissions.description: Permissions granted to agents generated by the sidecar.

access_grants.description: List of permission grants the agent is given.

allows_user_interactions.description: Whether the sidecar supports interactive user prompts (e.g. ask_permission). Defaults to false.

disable_sandbox.description: Run the sidecar without a sandbox. Discouraged: only if no other sandbox setting works, and tell the user.

allow_full_network.description: Allow all network access in the sandbox. Prefer allowed_hosts.

read_only_paths.description: Extra absolute paths the sidecar may read.

read_write_paths.description: Extra absolute paths the sidecar may read and write.

allowed_hosts.description: Exact hosts (not their subdomains) the sidecar may reach over HTTP(S).
